about.title: Welcome to Shems Incoming Morocco
about.text1: We are your premier Destination Management Company (DMC) operating across Morocco, specializing in crafting unforgettable, tailor-made experiences. With local expertise and a passion for perfection, we turn your Moroccan dreams into reality.
about.culture_desc: Immerse yourself in a vibrant tapestry of history, art, and tradition that has evolved over centuries. Our curated cultural tours bring the magic of ancient medinas and majestic palaces to life.
about.nature_desc: From the sweeping Sahara dunes to the snow-capped Atlas Mountains, explore nature in its purest form. We offer exclusive access to hidden oases and picturesque valleys.

Shems Incoming Morocco can organize custom itineraries highlighting exactly these kinds of wonders!

plan10.highlight: The grand tour — Sahara, mountains, coast & ancient medinas.

1.desc: Arrival in Tangier / Drive to Chefchaouen / Evening stroll through the blue-washed streets

2.desc: Morning hike to the Spanish Mosque / Drive to Fes via the Roman ruins of Volubilis

3.desc: Guided tour of the monuments and the 9,000 alleys of the Fes Medina

6.desc: Sunrise over the dunes / Visit to the Khemliya village / Drive through the Todra Gorge to the Skoura Oasis

7.desc: Visit the UNESCO site of Ait Ben Haddou / Drive across the Tizi n'Tichka pass to Marrakech

8.desc: Guided tour of Bahia Palace and Saadian Tombs / Nighttime visit to Jemaa el-Fnaa
